title: Make build robust without unrelated provider keys
tasks: Ensure build and page-data generation do not fail from missing optional provider keys.
Document required vs optional secrets in app startup and integration layers.
Add deterministic fallback behavior for provider-dependent paths without weakening security.
Capture evidence that static generation and route checks remain stable under minimal environment settings.
definition_of_done: Static build remains green when optional provider keys are absent or placeholder.
Route-level behavior degrades safely for non-critical provider operations.
Environment contract for local/CI/runtime secret requirements is documented.
Build and lint evidence is refreshed and archived.
